acv.quote: Two hundred and ten K ACV

data.reason: Won memberships only after Tobi showed which failed renewals in their own file could be recovered. Greg, the controller, then signed. The AE first credited Maya. Front desks stay with Global.

trigger.action: Lead with how much churn is really failed cards.
trigger.why: Corelane's board churn rose two quarters, and the failed-card share was bigger than anyone expected.
trigger.quote: The second bucket was a lot bigger than anyone expected.

decider.action: Show the controller recovered renewals in their own numbers.
decider.why: Greg, the controller, sat on the contract two weeks, then signed four days after seeing their own data.
decider.quote: Greg decided whether anybody got chosen.

competitor.action: Answer contract length and the cost of leaving in plain terms.
competitor.why: After Global's offer, which the rep only heard about from Maya, questions turned to contract terms and exit costs.
competitor.quote: what's the contract term, what does it cost to get out

message.action: Replace 'unified commerce' with plain words about front-desk readers.
message.why: When the rep said 'unified commerce,' Maya, the head of digital, asked whether it just meant the readers.

proof.action: Add a customer story of our reader inside studio software.
proof.why: Maya wanted check-in and sales on one screen, saw only a partner demo, and the front desks stayed with Global.

words.action: Say 'members who never meant to leave' instead of 'reduce churn'.
words.why: Maya, the head of digital, used this phrase for members lost to failed cards.
words.quote: members who never meant to leave.
